loader.description: Pantalla de carga: Homer vs Mr. Burns jugando una partida REAL y correcta de Magic. Vertical 9:16 mobile.
loader.prompt: A humorous 2D cartoon scene of a card match in the classic Simpsons art style, vertical portrait composition, aspect ratio 9:16. Homer Simpson and Mr. Burns are seated properly and facing each other across a desk in the nuclear reactor control room, playing a game of Magic. Homer is eating a donut and looking intensely focused on a hand of cards, while Mr. Burns has an evil smirk. Both characters hold their cards facing themselves (only the card backs are visible to the camera). On the table, a detailed Magic: The Gathering card layout is displayed: rows of fantasy cards with some cards turned horizontally at 90-degrees to indicate they are tapped, next to an open pink donut box and a can of Duff beer. In the background, Waylon Smithers stands looking concerned and taking notes on a notepad. Warm control room lighting, bold outlines, vibrant colors. --ar 9:16 --no text, watermark, signature, UI, buttons, backward cards
